name: Caolte

attributes.attribute: hero whose name Yeats favoured in this spelling

text: Caolte is the spelling the poet William Butler Yeats favoured for the hero Caílte mac Rónáin. Yeats chose this form in his own writings. The warrior's complete story appears under the standard headword Caílte.
